views.markdown: **The iOS 26 Apple Music look, on iOS 16.** Liquid glass everywhere.

- **Floating Now Playing pill**: a glass pill with album art, play and skip
- **Dynamic Pill**: swipe up on the pill and it grows into Insights, like the Dynamic Island
- **Insights**: your listening this week, streak, top artist and songs, all time
- **Sleep Timer** that morphs right out of the island
- **Landscape player**: turn your phone sideways for a full-screen player with timed lyrics
- **Jelly swipe to skip** on the pill
- **Shrinks as you scroll**, next to liquid glass Home and Search circles
- **iOS 26 artist pages**: big Play button, favorite star and an About sheet
- **Up Next preview** pops out of the pill before a song ends
- **Animated album covers** right in the player
- **Album color glow**: the pill tints to the cover
- **Hold to peek**: cover, live lyric line and time
- **Song change splash** and **share cards** for your stories
- **AND MORE**

views.title: iOS 26 Packages — get all of them at once

views.text: Made by nano · iPhone 13 Pro Max tested

views.markdown:
- **Better liquid drop**: a slight pull makes a soft bump that rises into a drop on a pinching neck, and it quivers while you hold it
- **Pull anywhere**: the drop comes up wherever your finger is along the pill's top edge
- **Height limit**: pull past it and the Dynamic Pill opens right away; let go after a good pull and it opens too; a small pull goes back in
- **Matching close**: the Dynamic Pill closes back into the same drop, right where you pulled it from
- Bug fixes

- **Liquid Dynamic Pill**: it opens as liquid poured up out of the drop, and closes back into a drop that gets sucked into the pill with a bounce
- **Faster and smoother**: quicker pull, open and close, with smoother drawing while it moves
- **Sleep Timer Back button**: go back to Insights right from the Sleep Timer
- Bug fixes

- **Liquid pull**: pull up on the pill and a drop of liquid glass rises out of it, follows your finger and wobbles. Let go and the Dynamic Pill grows right out of the drop
- **Dynamic Pill closing**: closes on one smooth spring, then bounces into the real pill
- **New player close**: the player shrinks evenly into the pill and lands exactly on it
- **Locked pill**: the pill keeps one size and spot (no more resizing after leaving Music or scrolling)
- **Smooth Lyrics** (optional, landscape): lyrics follow every frame, glide, karaoke fill, depth, breathing ••• in breaks, and a ± timing nudge per song
- **Song Change Splash**: shows the moment a new song plays, new bubble look when the pill is minimized, hides while paused
- **Settings demo**: shows the liquid pull and the splash
- Bug fixes

- **Hold to peek**: hold the pill and it grows a little with the cover, the lyric being sung and the time
- **Song change splash** (optional): a new song makes the pill grow with the big cover, tap it to open the player
- **Share card**: share a story-size picture of what you're playing from Insights
- **Smoother Dynamic Pill**: opens from your finger, closes like the Dynamic Island, pull it down to close
- **Landscape**: animated icons, a volume that reacts, centered lyrics, a Favorite star and Up Next
- **Big Cover With Lyrics** (optional): big cover next to the lyrics, tap to pause, swipe to change songs
- **Hide Home Bar in Landscape** (optional)
- Bug fixes

- **Dynamic Pill**: swipe up on the now playing pill and it grows into Insights, just like the Dynamic Island. Tap outside and it shrinks back into the pill
- **Insights**: your listening this week, day by day, your streak, top artist, top songs and all time
- **Sleep Timer** now morphs out of the island (15, 30, 45 min, 1 hour or end of song)
- **Landscape player**: turn your phone sideways for a full-screen player with the cover, controls, AirPlay and colors from the album. No status bar, home bar along the bottom
- **Lyrics in landscape**: timed lyrics that light up line by line, tap a line to jump there
- **Jelly swipe to skip**: the pill stretches and bounces as you swipe
- **Live waveform** on the cover while music plays (optional)
- **Tap to open the player**
- **Smaller pill on the Library tab** (optional)
- **Still background** in landscape when Increase Contrast is on
- **Redesigned settings** with a new icon and an animated Dynamic Pill demo
- **LiquidAss compatibility** switch
- Bug fixes
